en.name: Flaxseed, whole
en.summary: Whole flaxseed keeps 2 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. The intact seed coat keeps air off the very fragile oil inside, which is why it needs no refrigeration — the exact opposite of the advice for ground flaxseed.
en.pantry: 2 years from purchase, sealed, cool, dark and dry. Flax oil is one of the most easily oxidised fats in the store cupboard, but in a whole seed it is sealed behind a hard, waxy coat, so oxygen barely reaches it. What limits a jar in practice is damp and pantry insects rather than rancidity, so an airtight jar or tin beats the paper bag it came in.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for whole flaxseed, and none is needed. Cold does the seed no harm and in a humid summer kitchen it is a reasonable place for a big bag, but it buys nothing that a sealed jar in a cool cupboard does not already give you. If you do chill it, let the closed container come back to room temperature before opening so condensation does not settle on the seed.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, for the same reason: whole seed is already stable for years at room temperature. Freezing is not wrong — it is a sensible way to park a bulk sack, and a spell in the freezer settles any insect eggs that came in with it — but it is not something the seed requires.
en.thawing: Nothing to thaw. If you have kept a bag cold, let it warm to room temperature while still sealed before you open it.
spoilage: A bitter, fishy or paint-like smell when you crack a few seeds between your teeth.
Seeds stuck together in clumps, meaning moisture has got into the jar.
Mould or a musty cellar smell in a bag that got damp.
Webbing, moths or grubs — pantry insects find seeds quickly.
tips: Buy whole and grind only what you need for the week; the milled meal is far more fragile.
Decant into an airtight jar or tin rather than leaving it in the paper bag.
Write the purchase date on the jar — whole seed outlives most people's memory of buying it.
Taste a few seeds before grinding a batch; bitterness carries straight into the food.

faq.q: How long does whole flaxseed keep?
faq.a: 2 years from purchase in a sealed container in a cool, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Does whole flaxseed need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. The seed coat protects the oil, so a cupboard is enough. Ground flaxseed is the one that needs cold storage.

faq.q: How can you tell if flaxseed has gone bad?
faq.a: Crush a few seeds and smell them. Rancid flax is bitter and distinctly fishy. Clumping, mould or insects are the other reasons to bin a jar.

zh.name: 亞麻仁籽（整粒）
zh.summary: 整粒亞麻仁籽自購買日起，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 2 年。完整的種皮把空氣擋在外面，裡面那層極脆弱的油才不會走味，所以它不需要冷藏——和亞麻仁籽粉的建議剛好相反。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 2 年。亞麻油是廚房裡最容易氧化的油脂之一，但在整粒種子裡，它被一層硬而帶蠟質的種皮封住，氧氣幾乎進不去。實際上先把一罐亞麻籽終結掉的，通常是受潮和米蟲，而不是油耗，所以氣密玻璃罐或鐵罐會比原本那個紙袋可靠得多。
zh.fridge: 整粒亞麻仁籽沒有冷藏的期限數據，也不需要。低溫不會傷到種子，台灣夏天濕熱，把一大包放冰箱也算合理，但它給不了密封罐加陰涼櫥櫃給不了的東西。真的要冰，請讓密封的容器先回到室溫再打開，免得水氣凝結在種子上。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，理由一樣：整粒種子在室溫下本來就能穩定好幾年。冷凍並不算錯——大包裝先冰起來很合理，低溫也能順便處理掉跟著進來的蟲卵——但這不是亞麻籽非做不可的事。
zh.thawing: 沒有東西要解凍。如果冰過，請讓袋子維持密封回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 咬破幾粒聞起來發苦、有魚腥味或油漆味。
種子黏成一團，代表罐子裡進了水氣。
受潮的袋子長霉或有地窖般的霉味。
出現蛾、絲網或蟲——米蟲找到種子的速度很快。
tips: 買整粒，一次只磨一週的量；磨好的粉脆弱得多。
倒進氣密玻璃罐或鐵罐，不要就放在原本的紙袋裡。
在罐上寫購買日期，整粒種子的壽命通常比人的記性長。
磨之前先嚼幾粒，苦味會原封不動進到食物裡。

faq.q: 整粒亞麻仁籽可以放多久？
faq.a: 自購買日起，密封放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 2 年。
不用。種皮會保護裡面的油，放櫥櫃就夠了。需要低溫保存的是磨好的亞麻仁籽粉。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷亞麻仁籽壞了？
faq.a: 壓碎幾粒聞聞看。走味的亞麻籽會發苦、帶明顯魚腥味。結塊、長霉或生蟲則是另外三個該丟的理由。
